WL023.badStep: Step {stepOrder} is set to show a picture from step {sourceOrder}, but that step does not come earlier or cannot produce a picture or video. The step would stop.

lint.WL024: The {actor} is set to show a picture or video from {start} to {end}, but that is not a valid moment in the film. The step would stop.
lint.WL025: The {actor} keeps a full-screen card on screen for {seconds} seconds. A card should stay under 25% of the film or 30 seconds.
lint.WL028: The app field “{input}” is required and has no value. The run would be refused.
lint.WL029: The value of “{input}” does not fit the setting it fills. The run would be refused.

WL030.message: The model chosen for “{input}” can no longer be used. The run would be refused.
WL030.recommended: The model “{input}” starts with can no longer be used, so people will have to choose another one.

lint.WL031: When “{input}” is {value}, {count, plural, one {# step does} other {# steps do}} not run.
lint.WL032: “{input}” changes the model of an agent that {count} steps use, so all of them use the model chosen.
lint.WL033: With the dearest choice of “{input}”, {actor} could cost about {credits} credits, more than its cap of {cap}. Such a run would stop at the cap.

WL034.useSibling: {actor} shows an avatar or an object, but its model “{model}” takes no pictures. Use “{sibling}” instead. The step would be refused before anything is charged.
WL034.noSibling: {actor} shows an avatar or an object, but its model “{model}” takes no pictures. Choose a model that takes pictures. The step would be refused before anything is charged.

callToAction.label: Call to action
callToAction.help: The last thing the video asks people to do.

backgroundLook.label: Background look
backgroundLook.help: The colours and mood of the soft moving backgrounds.

audience.label: Who it is for
audience.help: The people the video speaks to.

captions.label: Captions
captions.help: Shows the spoken words on screen.

musicVolume.label: Music volume
musicVolume.help: Leave it empty to let the editor choose.

footageSounds.label: Sounds on filmed footage too
footageSounds.help: Off: sounds go on designed moments, not on plain cuts between filmed shots.

lookModel.label: Model that looks at the picture

mostLooks.label: Most looks at the picture
mostLooks.help: Leave it empty and the length of the video decides. 0 switches the looks off. When looks are on, the sound designer may ask for up to 6 more.

bRollShots.label: Most extra shots
bRollShots.help: The most extra AI shots to plan and make. Fewer shots cost less.

bRollModel.label: Video model for the extra shots

mostCredits.label: Most credits to spend
mostCredits.help: The most credits the extra AI shots may cost this run. The estimate shows what it will cost.

bRollCredits.label: Most credits to spend on extra shots
bRollCredits.help: The most credits the extra AI shots may cost this run.

mostShots.label: Most extra shots
mostShots.help: The most extra AI shots to plan and make. Fewer shots cost less.

takesPerShot.label: Versions per shot
takesPerShot.help: How many versions of each extra shot to make and choose from. More versions cost more.

whatToHide.label: What to hide
whatToHide.help: Name the object in plain words. It is followed through the whole clip.

liteMode.label: Lite mode (cheaper)
liteMode.help: Cheaper: one still picture of the person, animated to speak your words.

whatTheyDo.label: What they do
whatTheyDo.example: Greets the viewer warmly in a bright studio and looks into the camera

whatTheySay.label: What they say
whatTheySay.help: Spoken word for word, up to about 15 seconds. A blank line starts a new spoken line.
whatTheySay.example: Welcome to Caffè Lume! Our new autumn menu starts today.

footageCaptions.label: Captions
footageCaptions.help: Shows the words spoken in your footage on screen.

ending.label: Ending fade
ending.help: Fades the picture and the sound out at the very end.

voiceover.label: Spoken voiceover
voiceover.help: A narrator reads the script over the video. Uses a voice.

ownWords.label: I will write the words
ownWords.help: Off: you give a topic and the words are written for you. On: the person says exactly what you type.

topic.label: Topic
topic.help: What the person should explain, in a sentence or two.
topic.example: Why our new autumn menu uses local ingredients

explainerWords.label: What they say
explainerWords.help: Spoken word for word, up to about 15 seconds. A blank line starts a new spoken line.
explainerWords.example: Hi, I'm Giulia. Our autumn menu is here, and everything on it is grown nearby.

musicPrompt.label: Describe the music
musicPrompt.help: The mood, the instruments and the pace.
musicPrompt.example: Warm acoustic guitar, easy pace, hopeful

sfxPrompt.label: Describe the sound
sfxPrompt.help: What makes the sound and where it happens.
sfxPrompt.example: A wooden door creaking open in a quiet hall

audioTakes.label: Takes
audioTakes.help: How many versions to make and choose from. More takes cost more.

atTime.label: Time in the video
atTime.help: The second of the video to use as the cover.

coverText.label: Cover text
coverText.help: A short line written on the cover. Leave it empty for a picture only.

textToSpeak.label: Text to read
textToSpeak.help: Spoken word for word. A blank line starts a new paragraph.
textToSpeak.example: Welcome to our shop. We are open every day from nine to six.

idea.label: Your idea
idea.help: What happens in the clip, in a sentence or two.
idea.example: Steam rising from a fresh espresso on a wooden counter, morning light

effort.label: How much effort
effort.help: Draft is the cheapest. Best of two makes two 10-second versions.

whatIsIt.label: What is it
whatIsIt.help: Tells the editor what to look for.

soundEffects.label: Sound effects
soundEffects.help: Hits, whooshes and clicks placed on the action.

captionsStyle.label: Captions
captionsStyle.help: Shows the spoken words on screen.

quickMode.label: Lite mode (cheaper)
quickMode.help: A plain cut with captions and transitions: the extras below are ignored and there is no AI review.

music.label: Music
music.help: Off by default. On mixes a track from this project's music files under the voices, lowered while people speak.

motion.label: Zooms and camera moves
motion.help: On by default, subtle: pushes, pulls and shakes placed on the action in the picture. Choose Off for none.

speedRamps.label: Speed ramps
speedRamps.help: On by default: slow motion and speed-ups on the action. Works with zooms and camera moves.

flashes.label: Flashes
flashes.help: On by default: a short flash on the hits. Works with zooms and camera moves.

graphics.label: Graphics
graphics.help: Words and shapes drawn over the picture where it has room.

colourLook.label: Colour look
colourLook.help: A grade chosen by an AI colour team.

bRoll.label: Extra AI shots
bRoll.help: Up to four short AI shots cut in. They are paid, with a fixed cap you see before you run.

narrate.label: Voice-over
narrate.help: A narration written for what is kept, spoken and captioned. Pick its language and voice below.

fixLines.label: Fix flubbed lines
fixLines.help: Re-records stumbled lines in your project voice. Needs speech in the video.

cutOnEvents.label: Cut on the action
cutOnEvents.help: On by default: lets cuts land on things that happen in the picture.

subtitles.label: Subtitles
subtitles.help: Burned into the picture; SRT and VTT files come with them.

translate.label: Translate the subtitles
translate.help: Into the language chosen below, always burned in. Off keeps the spoken language.

dub.label: Dub
dub.help: Replaces the voices with a spoken translation in the target language. The lips are not re-synced.

hideTarget.label: What to hide
hideTarget.help: Name the object in plain words. It is followed through the whole clip.

followTarget.label: What to follow
followTarget.help: Name the subject in plain words. The camera keeps it in frame.
followTarget.example: the dancer in the red jacket
